author: Inside Edition
description:
A family was having a relaxing day with their dog frolicking outside until chaos erupted. A bobcat seized the tiny yorkie, Ariel, and ran off with her clamped in its mouth. Claudia Asberry and her pooch were visiting her daughter's home in Frisco, Texas when the predator struck. The family fought off the beast. Ariel survived and needed emergency surgery. Asberry says later in the day they took a picture of the bobcat. A dramatic end to a quiet family day.

A GoFundMe has been set up to help with Ariel's vet bills For more information, you can click this link: https://www.gofundme.com/f/help-ariel-recover-after-bobcat-attack-eq4bn
title: Family Fights Off Bobcat That Snatched Pet Dog

author: Inside Edition
description: Don't adjust the color on your screen. This lobster is actually two different shades of red. The split-colored crustacean was found off the coast of Cape Cod and is apparently very rare. Even though it was caught by a lobster boat, its life will be spared so that it can be put on display at an aquarium in Woods Hole, Massachusetts.
title: Rare 2-Toned Lobster Caught Off Coast Of Cape Cod #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: California nurse Diana Sanders says she was on the first day of a Carnival Cruise with two friends when she drank 15 shots of tequila in just over eight hours. She claims that she then blacked out and was seriously injured after falling down a flight of stairs. She sued Carnival, claiming they negligently over-served her alcohol and a jury recently awarded her $300,000 in damages. Carnival denies the allegations and says it will appeal the verdict. Jim Moret spoke with Sanders in this exclusive interview.
title: Woman Awarded $300k By Jury After Drinking 15 Shots Of Tequila On A Cruise

author: Inside Edition
description: A man is using AI to help himself see better, and it's a creation he wants to share with all who struggle with sight. UK-based David Sikhurildze says these smart glasses take pictures of what's in front of a person and measure the distance between them. It also has microphones and speakers to communicate with the system. According to CBS News, this technology is assistive, and not meant to completely replace a cane or a seeing eye dog. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Visually Impaired Man Creates Smart Glasses Powered By AI
